<!-- sequence-goal-open-points human-comment -->
## Input needed before this goal can be completed

- **docs/sequence-diagrams/vaa-eapi-myaccount-under18-enrolment.md**: External Azure DevOps ticket IDs are not required for this implementation; the code-level contract in this diagram is the delivery baseline.
- **docs/sequence-diagrams/vaa-eapi-myaccount-under18-enrolment.md**: `MyAccount:DeDupFCGenUrl` is treated as synchronous for this mutation. Household linking is attempted only when its response contains both a customer ID and member number.
- **docs/sequence-diagrams/vaa-eapi-myaccount-under18-enrolment.md**: This delivery does not add retry or compensation orchestration. A link failure returns a controlled error after enrolment; retry safety remains with the existing DeDup and Member Management eligibility/link idempotency contracts. An event-driven reconciliation flow requires a separately owned follow-up design.

The implementation has passed verification and remains `InProgress` until these points are answered.
